mapper.sql: id, name, device_type_id, location, status, serial_number, manufacturer, purchase_date, warranty_expiry, description, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM device ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device (name, device_type_id, location, status, serial_number, manufacturer, purchase_date, warranty_expiry, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{deviceTypeId}, #{location}, #{status}, #{serialNumber}, #{manufacturer}, #{purchaseDate}, #{warrantyExpiry}, #{description}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO device (name, device_type_id, location, status, serial_number, manufacturer, purchase_date, warranty_expiry, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{d.name}, #{d.deviceTypeId}, #{d.location}, #{d.status}, #{d.serialNumber}, #{d.manufacturer}, #{d.purchaseDate}, #{d.warrantyExpiry}, #{d.description}, #{d.createdAt}, #{d.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM device GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM device WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
